objective: Retain bounded native CLASSES source bytes without imposing a byte copy on existing 2D consumers or promoting support claims.

implemented.bytes: shared_ptr<const vector<uint8_t>>, copied from the actual physical or decoded section, not reconstructed class metadata

lineages.reader15: Physical section capture through an independent cursor/error state
lineages.reader18: Decoded envelope capture before cleanup; includes the bounded zero-filled capacity used by the existing parser
lineages.reader21: Decoded temporary section capture before destruction
lineages.reader24_27_32: Inherited reader18 capture hook, not separate native qualification

profile: Raw codepage id, presence and recognition
Copied byte count on success; attempted extent on failure
Class-read and parser-coverage completion observations, not independent certificates
implemented.budgetBoundary: Payload request is checked before allocation; adapter aggregate estimates also charge vector capacity, owner and map-node overhead. These are not a whole-process peak-memory guarantee.
implemented.callbackBoundary: Request/capture/delivery exceptions do not change the ordinary parse result. A throwing consumer must invalidate its own partial retention; an already copied shared owner cannot be revoked by the reader.
implemented.converterRetention: Private current-generation read-only reports; duplicate/context/allocation/budget failure is explicit. Failure consumes no retained-byte charge. Later generations may retry within remaining aggregate limits; public class-row edits cannot replace the retained source lease.

specificationReview.boundary: Capture preserves physical/decoded address-space distinctions and declared versus decoded-capacity sizes. It does not independently verify sentinels, CRCs, lengths, string footers or BS/BL record-profile selection.

controls.faultSeam: Scoped translation-unit allocation countdown, request exceptions and delivery exceptions; no assertions or setup allocations inside injected allocation failure windows
coverage: Null/default-false handlers allocate no source bytes
RequestFailed and NotCaptured do not become empty valid sections
Exact cap, over-cap, zero cap, null and invalid backing ranges
Separate declared size and copied decoded capacity
Source mutation after capture does not alter the frozen copied bytes
Once-only delivery, allocation failures and fresh-attempt recovery
Memory/file-backed physical cursor, cached bit state and next-read continuity
Physical fork allocation failures do not poison the publishing buffer
Converter duplicate callback, later-generation retry and no stale fallback
Exact/one-under aggregate budget, report-count limit and map allocation failure
Malformed report status, ownership, count, address space and overflow refusals
Read-only report/shared-const byte API compile assertions
Native capture/no-copy parser-result and class-row comparisons
Native reader lifetime and repeated-import independent source-owner retention
controls.scratchControl: Runtime-generated 32-byte cursor.bin, not a drawing fixture
controls.adapterBuildSharing: Fifth explicitly audited tests/ target reuses the identical adapter-object compile context; configure-time context comparator and build-context regression pass

validation.libreCAD3CompileGate: PASS: lc3_compat_check rebuilt with unchanged established DRW_Interface callback contract
validation.cohortPolicy: Affected owning and reader/consumer cohorts ran sequentially, at most three tests per cohort. ASan targets only source capture; no overlapping heavy owning cohorts.
validation.fullSuite: NOT_RUN: focused validation plus affected owning checkpoints only

Malformed/truncated/profile-mutated source, producer >=256 fields, complete failure/retry and native lineage gates before clearing class/text admission issues
